name: subtube-extension
description: Chrome extension that signs the subtube web app in to Google and checks which videos are Shorts.
author: Erik Brinkman

scripts.export:bundle: bun build src/background.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --minify
scripts.export:static: cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp -r icons dist/icons
scripts.export: rm -rf dist && bun export:bundle && bun export:static
scripts.pack: rm -rf store subtube-extension.zip && bun build src/background.ts --outdir store --target browser --format esm --minify && cp -r icons store/icons && jq 'del(.key) | .externally_connectable.matches |= map(select(startswith("http:") | not))' manifest.json > store/manifest.json && (cd store && zip -r -X ../subtube-extension.zip .) && rm -rf store
scripts.icons: rm -rf icons && mkdir icons && rsvg-convert -w 16 -h 16 ../design/icons/sub-play-centred-small.svg -o icons/icon-16.png && rsvg-convert -w 32 -h 32 ../design/icons/sub-play-centred.svg -o icons/icon-32.png && rsvg-convert -w 48 -h 48 ../design/icons/sub-play-centred.svg -o icons/icon-48.png && rsvg-convert -w 128 -h 128 ../design/icons/sub-play-centred.svg -o icons/icon-128.png
